task: Fix crash on Book tab 'Continue Listening' for multi-hour audiobooks: loadAndPlay always reset duration to 0, so PlayerBar's fitsLegibly(0,...) bootstrap ('unknown duration -> show the waveform') let WaveformStrip start a full wavesurfer decode of the entire assembled audiobook (hundreds of MB, many hours) before real <audio> metadata loaded.

frontend/src/store/playerBus.ts.summary: Added optional LoadAndPlayOptions.initialDuration; loadAndPlay() now seeds state.duration from it (defaulting to 0, unchanged for existing callers). Lets callers that already know the real duration (backend metadata) skip PlayerBar's unknown-duration bootstrap window entirely.

frontend/src/pages/Book/components/Conti.summary: handlePlay() now passes initialDuration: latest.duration_seconds to loadAndPlay(), so the Book tab's 'Continue Listening' button never triggers the risky unknown-duration window for a multi-hour assembled audiobook.

frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail/compone.summary: Same fix applied to the Project Library hover-play overlay's loadAndPlay call, which has the identical book-scope full-audiobook crash risk.

flow_impact: Confirmed live in browser against a real 14h24m/426.6MB assembled audiobook: Continue Listening now starts with the real duration (864:00) from the first render and a plain slider immediately, no wavesurfer decode attempt, no hang. RESIDUAL RISK (not fixed in this change, flagged to owner): the wave-toggle button is still reachable for book-scope playback and, since tapeAvailable is permanently false for book scope (no chapter peaks-sidecar route applies), manually clicking it still forces WaveformStrip into a full inline decode of the entire multi-hour file -- the same underlying danger via a different (manual, not automatic) trigger. A future fix should disable/hide the wave-toggle for book scope, or gate WaveformStrip from ever attempting a decode above some duration ceiling regardless of forceWave.
